decision.rationale: TXN-008023 is on card CRD-000180 at Larkspur Fuel (MER-000057). It posted on 2026-08-30, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, which is 60 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 9748 cents (97.48 EUR). Authorisation AUTH-008220 was for 6770 cents (chip, PIN verified, approved). The merchant's own receipt, DOC-000048, shows a total of 67.70 EUR (6770 cents). The posted amount is above both the receipt and the authorised amount. Under amount-above-receipt, the difference of 9748 - 6770 = 2978 cents (29.78 EUR) was charged without agreement. Only that difference is credited, not the whole transaction. It matches the amount the cardholder claimed. It is well below the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit in provisional-credit. The case documents contained no instructions.
